$comment: Prompt text for the bundled pack (CC BY-SA 4.0). Keys under "prompts" must match PROMPT_NAMES in internal/lobby/prompts.go — the six a pack supplies. Keys under "system" are the house's own phrases (docs/PACKS.md: outside the pack contract, installed beside it as system/), spoken by announcements such as the low-balance call; a pack never has to supply them. Re-run prompts/build.sh after editing. To ship this as a distributable pack, see docs/PACKS.md.

prompts.lobby-greeting: Welcome to the phone lobby. Please dial an extension within ten seconds.
prompts.invalid-extension: That isn't an extension here. Try again.

system.balance-low: This is the house phone. The calling credit is running low. It is down to about
system.quiet-refused: Fifteen, thirty, or forty-five minutes. Try again.
system.quiet-room: That phone isn't taking calls for another
system.quiet-page: One phone is quiet. The others heard you.
system.curfew-out: This phone is asleep for the night. You can call nine one one, or use the reminder numbers star eighty, star eighty one, and star eighty two.
system.curfew-room: That phone is asleep for the night.
system.add-number: Key in the number, then press pound.
system.add-name: After the beep, say the name, then hang up or press pound.
system.add-done: Got it. It will be in your phone book shortly.
system.reminder-menu-80: Call back today at a time you choose.
system.reminder-menu-81: Call back in a few hours or minutes.
system.reminder-call-80: This is the call you scheduled by dialing star eight zero.
system.reminder-call-81: This is the call you scheduled by dialing star eight one.
system.reminder-call-82: This is the call you scheduled by dialing star eight two.
system.reminder-none: This phone has no pending calls. Let us schedule one.
system.reminder-pending: Here are all the pending calls for this phone.
system.reminder-retrying: This call is due or waiting for a retry. The next queued attempt is
system.reminder-cancel: To cancel this call, press one. To keep it, press pound, or wait.
system.reminder-cancelled: Cancelled. If it is already ringing, it may ring for up to thirty seconds, but it will not play the message or retry.
system.reminder-changed: That call is no longer pending.
system.reminder-new: To schedule another call, press one. Otherwise, press pound or hang up.
system.reminder-full: This phone already has ten pending calls. Cancel one before adding another.
system.reminder-ampm: Press one for A M, or two for P M. Press star to start again.
system.reminder-time: Enter the hour and two digits for the minutes, then press pound. For seven thirty, enter seven three zero. Press star to start again.
system.reminder-hours: Enter the number of hours from zero to nine. Press star to start again.
system.reminder-minutes: Enter the number of minutes from zero to ninety nine, then press pound. Extra minutes carry over into hours. Press star to start again.
system.reminder-invalid: That could not be converted to a time. No call has been scheduled.
system.reminder-past: That time has already passed today. No call has been scheduled. For a delay instead, hang up and dial star eight one.
system.reminder-try-again: Try again, then press pound. Press star to exit.
system.reminder-message: To record a reminder message, press one. For the standard message, press pound, or wait. Press star to start again.
system.reminder-record: After the beep, record your message, up to one minute. Press pound when finished. Press star to start again. Hanging up cancels this unfinished request.
system.reminder-unavailable: Sorry, the request could not be completed. Please try again later.
system.reminder-due: This call is due or already ringing.
